details:
Our project is a *Virtual Space Museum* featuring 3D models of the satellites and exploration vehicles of Mars and the Moon. When visitors first enter the museum, they watch an introductory animation that presents the satellites and exploration vehicles. Behind each 3D model, visitors can find information explaining its purpose and importance. Our project is designed especially for primary and middle school students, as well as anyone interested in space.

The main benefit of our project is that it combines education and technology in an interactive and enjoyable way. Instead of only reading or listening to information, students can explore 3D models and learn through visual experiences. This makes learning easier, more engaging and accessible, especially for younger children.

Our main target audience is young students and their families. Teachers can also use the museum as an additional digital educational resource. We aim to make space exploration more enjoyable, increase children's curiosity about science and technology, and ensure that every child has the opportunity to learn about space.

What makes our project creative is that it explains space technology not only for adults but also in a simple and understandable way for younger generations.

Finally, our museum is completely free and accessible from any location through a link, using different technological devices.
